retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast mixed media layout featuring a loose ink-sketch portrait overlaid on geometric color blocks and textured photographic elements.
excludeWhen: clean digital vector portraits are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic collage combining a raw, gestural ink-line portrait with flat, saturated color fields (red, green, beige) and high-contrast photographic textures. The composition is anchored by a large, hand-drawn face that overlaps multiple background layers, creating a sense of depth and movement through intentional misalignment.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between loose, organic ink scribbles and rigid geometric color blocks
Typographic dominance of bright yellow against dark photographic textures
Layering of translucent and opaque shapes to create a shallow 3D effect
Asymmetrical balance between the large central head and smaller corner elements
coreInvariants: Gestural, continuous-line style for the facial features
High-saturation primary and secondary color palette
Visible paper or print texture in the background layers
Heavy use of black ink for shadows and hair texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, slightly off-center portrait head occupies 70% of the vertical space, overlapping the background layers.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central face, specifically the eyes and mouth rendered in thick black ink.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold yellow header, moves down the scribbled lines of the face, and settles on the smaller red text in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the space is filled with color blocks and textures, though the beige area provides a resting point for the eye.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Red and Deep Black (Structural blocks and ink lines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Yellow (Primary typography) and Muted Green (Secondary block)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value yellow and red pop against low-value black and mid-tone green.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to 5 core colors: Red, Yellow, Green, Black, Beige

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' is tightly curled to maintain the narrow width of the other characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact condensed sans-serif for the main title paired with a smaller, elegant serif for secondary information.

preserve: Lowercase serif for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the header.
Provides a sophisticated, classic contrast for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage background with a large red rectangle on the right, a green square at the bottom center, and a beige field on the left. In the center, place a large, loose ink-sketch portrait of a man with expressive, scribbled lines. Add a dark, textured photographic element in the top right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a bold, extra-condensed yellow sans-serif font across the top. Add a secondary word in a small, red serif font in the lower-left quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered in a loose, hand-drawn ink style?
Are the color blocks (red, green, beige) distinct and slightly misaligned?
Is the header text bright yellow and extremely condensed?
Does the composition feel like a 1960s-70s jazz/soul album cover?

adjustableVariables: Size and position of the color blocks
Specific hue of the red and green
Density of the photographic texture in the corner
mustRedesign: Avoid clean, perfect digital lines in the portrait
Do not use modern gradients; keep colors flat or textured like print
Ensure the typography does not have a drop shadow

mustAchieve: A sense of raw, expressive energy

postGenerationChecks: Verify the yellow text is legible against the background
Ensure the ink lines of the face overlap the color blocks
Check that the red serif text is small but distinct
Confirm the overall layout feels asymmetrical and dynamic
recipe.reuseFormula: Ink-Scribble Portrait + Geometric Color Blocks + Condensed Yellow Display Type = Soul Collage Aesthetic
